description: Experience the ultimate Caribbean getaway in this luxurious suite with a king bed, memory foam mattress, coffee machine, small fridge, TV, Wi-Fi, A/C, closet space and a shower. The room is located on the 3rd floor, accessible by stairs only and features an entire crystal wall with an ocean view. Please contact us with any questions or concerns. Property includes 2 pools, 3 buildings, free parking spaces, and Wi-Fi. We have no lifeguards on duty in pool areas. We have pet-friendly (pet fee*) rooms, you may see pets in common areas. We also have closed-circuit security cameras recording 24/7 in common areas for your safety. There are no cameras or audio recordings inside any private space of the unit. We are located in a rural area with fully paved roads, close to the beach, restaurants and other places of interest in a hillside surrounded by many trees and nature. It would be best to have a car rental to enjoy this beautiful town. If you have any questions about your room and/or reservation, please contact us through Airbnb inbox. We have staff on site during daytime hours in case you need assistance. Access to room will be sent through inbox around 3-4pm or as soon as the room is ready for use. Any changes must be processed at least 24 hours before arrival date. We have a non-visitor policy. Only registered guests are allowed to enter room or use facilities. Rooms have a maximum of guests. Please read room description before arrival day. Changes upon arrival are not possible most of the time because we have limited spaces. We check and document rooms before giving access. Expect some natural tear and wear of room. A/C’s must be kept on during your stay to prevent excessive moisture inside room. Cristal windows let in light but cannot be open to prevent damage to A/C and unwanted bugs inside room.Guest accessWelcome! You can check in any time as soon as you receive access to the room. The room has a lockbox with the key next to its door. Information is sent through Airbnb inbox. Nothing to sign at reception, you can go straight into the room when you arrive. We are posted in internet as “Serenity Rincon Guesthouse” If you have any questions someone will be available until 8pm every day of the week. We have free parking in open areas around the property. Please do not block entrance or other car. Our check out time is 11:30am. Please read “cancelation policies” and “Additional Rules” as reservation cannot be changed upon arrival. description: Casa Tsabar is a newly built, modern home situated in Puntas, offering stunning ocean and tropical valley views. It features three bedrooms with AC units, three bathrooms, a saltwater pool, and a Weber gas grill. It is fully stocked with all the amenities to ensure a relaxing and comfortable vacation with family and friends. Less than three minutes to Sandy Beach and several excellent restaurants in town, and 5 minutes to Maria's, Domes, and Steps Beach.The spaceThe house is located on a quiet and safe street. We have sweeping views of the Caribbean ocean and Aguadilla bay. At night one can star gaze or look off into the distance to see the twinkling lights across the bay. The house is fully stocked. The kitchen has every gadget you could imagine, spices, oils and vinegars, condiments etc. A Weber gas grill with gas provided linens, beach and bath towels, AC in all bedrooms, a washer & dryer and outdoor shower. The house comes equipped with solar panels and Lithium batteries to provide uninterrupted power in the event of a storm. We also have 1200 gallons of back up water in tanks should there be a water outage. We also provide a water filtration system and water softener to enhance the quality of the water that is pumped into the home. Other amenities provided: first aid kit, toilet paper, paper towels, trash bags, kitchen soap, sponges, detergent, shampoo, conditioner, bath soap, hand soap and more. Beach essentials: we offer beach towels, beach chairs, a beach umbrella and a few sets of snorkel equipment. We do not offer a beach blankets. This house is 2 levels with interior stairs. For guests with mobility issues there is a bedroom and full bath located on the main entry level.Guest accessYou are welcome to use the entire house, the pool, and the yard.Other things to noteCasa Tsabar was designed by Architect Sarah Strauss, AIA, of XS Architect, based in Brooklyn, NY, and Rincon, PR. The long, narrow proportions of the house are designed to capture cross breeze and to maximize views of the valley, sea, and Aguadilla Bay. The curved formwork wall was inspired by the sculptural work of Naama Tsabar, “Twilight (Gaffer Wall)”, 2006. This installation used vertical strips of black gaffer tape to construct a sensuous division.We provide air conditioning in all three bedrooms along with ceiling fans. The common areas feature floor-to-ceiling windows and ceiling fans, providing ample ventilation and a cross breeze.We reserve the right to cancel/limit bookings based on the number of nights during Holiday weeks/weekends (3-5 days) Exceptions to the rule apply.We are located on the western point of the island. We are 2.5 hours from SJU Airport, 30 minutes from both The Aguadilla Airport (BQN) and Mayaguez Airport (MAZ) airports, and 1.5 hours from PSE Airport in Ponce. Most renters fly into Aguadilla. Daily flights on JetBlue and United.To avoid the drive from San Juan, there is a Cape Air flight that goes directly multiple times a day from SJU to MAZ.

description: Prívate, unique seaside cottage with spectacular direct ocean views, private beach access on the property (right in front of the home) and secure parking in beautiful Rincón, Puerto Rico! Enjoy sunbathing, swimming, snorkeling, whale watching and star gazing. This charming and simple home features stunning views, and invites you to live like a local in an immersive and authentic barrio experience. You’ll spot iguanas, abundant marine life, and many different types of tropical birds and plants.The spacePropertyEnjoy our mesmerizing Rincón beach house with unparalleled ocean front access and views. Sun-filled, cozy 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom bungalow directly on the ocean (enjoy amazing trade winds year round!) with private guest access, parking, fully equipped kitchen, and ample indoor and outdoor living spaces. Internet is high-speed, and there is a smart TV (Netflix-ready!). This home is one of a kind, located both on the ocean AND within a short drive from the center of downtown Rincón, Puerto Rico, the surf capital of the Caribbean, with a diverse offering of shops, markets, restaurants, bars, and other exciting cultural activities.Please kindly note, although we have extraordinarily positive guest reviews, this is not a luxury resort or hotel with lavish accommodations. This is our actual beach home in an authentic, western Boricua neighborhood, and we enjoy sharing it on Airbnb with friendly, easy going travelers that are seeking to unwind in one of the most laid back towns in PR, Rincón. If you’re seeking a five-star, luxury hotel or resort experience for your vacation, our home may likely not align with your expectations, and we kindly encourage you to explore other local options.CancellationsWe understand that life happens. As a small business providing local employment, we hope that you understand our need to maintain a consistent cancellation policy. We recommend purchasing trip insurance that covers expenses from last-minute cancellations of lodging and transportation due to theft, medical, etc. or changes in your life circumstances. Airbnb and Travel Guard offer affordable options to ensure you're covered in the event of the unexpected.PestsPlease note that since we are located on a tropical island, from time to time you may see a dead bug or two in the cottage, especially with warmer and warmer temperatures. This is normal, to be expected and cannot be avoided. Doors should remain closed when possible to minimize pests (i.e. when loading/unloading the car, taking out the trash or hanging out on the porch). Bugs can get inside easily, especially in warmer weather. The cottage is treated inside & out by a pest control company for your comfort and safety.We stay on top of this costly pest control so please help us keep it effective - thank you!Local AnimalsWe love animals and rescued a Puerto Rican “sato” (stray dog), however we kindly ask that you do not feed any stray cats or dogs that are encountered in and around the property. If you feed them they stay and persistently seek more food which becomes difficult and uncomfortable for us as hosts and for other guests, especially those with severe allergies to animals. Let us know if you’d like to rescue a dog or cat, and we can help you!Guest accessGuests have full and complete access to this private home nestled by the seashore. Please note, there is an adjacent, private cottage also located on the backside of this long, ocean-front property, and each home has private, ocean-facing decks, reserved parking onsite, and completely different beach access points. Anyone accessing the second cottage enters by going down and behind this cottage so as not to interrupt or disturb guests' enjoyment of the private deck or ocean views. Additionally, each guest home features privacy deck screens and window shades for an added level of comfort and peace.Other things to noteThe ocean is your backyard and playground, come prepared to enjoy it comfortably! Plan to bring swim shoes for the shoreline, sunblock or sunscreen, a hat and sun glasses, and insect repellent (if bugs tend to bother you in tropical climates). Also, if you’d like to explore the underwater rocks and reefs, pack yourself snorkel gear. Beach towels to be used on the property are provided to guests.All guests can view our Guide Book in Airbnb with our suggestions for fun, local activities, the best dining options, and other practical tips for the area. Thank you in advance for treating our home as if it were your own during your stay. description: Immerse yourself in tranquility with breathtaking ocean views, mesmerizing sunsets, and complete privacy. This boutique 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom penthouse perched on the hillside of Puntas is just a short drive from world-class surf, historic landmarks, dining, and nightlife.
